name: 20690-longprefill-8b-1gpu
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct -- an ungated mirror of the gated meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, same architecture and same weights; ~16.1 GB of bf16 weights to fetch or have cached.
hardware: 1x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1), nothing else on the card.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1 -- one in-process vLLM engine on one GPU.
architecture: Dense decoder, grouped-query attention (LlamaForCausalLM): 32 layers, 32 query heads, 8 KV heads, head_dim 128, hidden 4096, bf16, 8.03B params, 128 KiB of KV per token.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1, warmup 10%, bounded at 200 requests with a 600 s safety cap. One stream is part of the declaration: time-to-first-token is then one prefill with no queueing term in it.
workload: `synthetic_text`, 10000 prompt tokens and 4 output tokens per request, no stdev, so every request is exactly that shape. `backend.request_format: plain` sends the prompt raw, with no chat template, matching the source's `--input-len 10000` synthetic prompt; add_special_tokens still puts the engine's own count a token above 10000, which is not drift. The 10000 is the operating point and must not be lowered.
purpose: A document analysis assistant reading 10,000-word submissions one at a time on a single H100, returning brief verdicts.
launch:
# The engine's command line: a long-prompt, short-answer deployment on one H100 at one request
# in flight, served through the Triton attention backend.

model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16

# 16384 is the smallest power of two admitting a 10000-token prompt plus its chat template.
# Written out rather than inherited, and neither may be lowered.
max-model-len: 16384
max-num-batched-tokens: 16384

block-size: 16
max-num-seqs: 256
enable-prefix-caching: false

# The attention backend cannot be written here: this engine has no `attention_backend` argument,
# so the VLLM_ATTENTION_BACKEND environment variable is the only selector.
